text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Measurement bandwidth limits magnitude fidelity and phase fidelity

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: H(jf)=1/(1+jf/f_c). Shading 0.1–1 Hz illustrates a stricter usable band, not a universal bandwidth rule. For a selected signal band f_max, choose
f_s>2f_max with margin; the analog anti-alias filter must adequately attenuate content at and above f_s/2. Sensor roll-off alone may be insufficient.
